decision: Run exactly one corrected M=1/16/32 real-QKV component falsifier on the retained H200. The final owner-control bytes are closed; ordinary pre-decision integration failures remain repairable inside the same claim without changing immutable science.

bench.initial_state: Strict SSH and exact H200 identity verified; last observed available and unclaimed; zero containers and zero GPU compute processes at the last quiescence check; component and image are not assumed resident.

lifecycle.deadline_rule: Release by the earlier of claimed_at plus 2400 seconds and 08:39:00Z. Preserve at least seven minutes after the terminal target for durable terminal, generation-fenced release, and diagnostics. Do not approach the 09:01:39Z provider cleanup boundary.

owner_contract: Atomically claim the exact bench and persist the returned claimed_at generation.
Adopt and heartbeat before immutable staging; a pre-adoption failure releases only the exact generation.
Stage only the hash-bound scientific files, verify remote hashes, and atomically finalize them.
Pull or reuse only the pinned image and expose exactly GPU-e26e853a-ce3b-8874-bd3e-6db51a22f8b3.
Run the unchanged repetitions-100 component consumer once after science_started.
Keep a real same-claim repair dispatcher after recoverable pre-decision failure and re-enter only the invalidated phase.
Persist the typed terminal and release the exact generation after a decision-bearing result; release to maintenance with diagnostics on heartbeat loss or absolute deadline.

scientific_invocation.invalid_attempt_rule: A pre-ledger launcher or integration failure, or a partial invocation with no complete interpretable candidate row ledger, is diagnostic rather than a canonical sample and may be repaired without changing immutable science.

acceptance.correctness: Every M=1/16/32 activation byte, FP32 scale byte, and real-QKV consumer byte is exact; candidate nonfinite count is zero.
acceptance.execution: Candidate path identity, exact H200 identity, CUDA graph capture/replay, loaded component orientation/strides, and compiler registers/shared-memory/spills are complete.
acceptance.performance: The complete contemporaneous M32 candidate real-QKV component median is below its baseline median.
acceptance.positive: Only correctness, execution, and performance together promote the corrected source toward one later endpoint integration.
acceptance.negative: A complete ledger with any exactness/path/graph failure or non-positive M32 timing closes this corrected decomposition without replay.

prohibitions: Do not run the rejected source.
Do not run endpoint, R5, stock replay, or any second canonical component sample.
Do not change immutable science, the provider lifecycle, the watchdog, or another project.
Do not release a recoverable unconsumed attempt merely because the initial claim-start fence has elapsed; use the bounded same-claim repair path while the absolute window still fits.
